Given that NbN and TiN share the same diamond crystal structure, the diffraction peaks observed for NbTiN should correspond to the (111) and (002) planes seen in diffraction analysis of bulk NbN and TiN 28,42–44. Figure 7 depicts the XRD spectra for a 3:1 Nb:Ti cycle ratio showing features near 35 ◦ and 41 ◦ which match the (111) and (002) cubic δ peaks.
